method: Read-only source comparison against approved ground, recorded workload comparison and fresh same-session approved-ground timings. No source changes or speculative optimizations.
verified: src/game3d/terrain.ts and groundMaterial.ts are unchanged against approved-ground base.
createGroundMaterial is instantiated once and assigned only to terrain chunk meshes.
main.ts diff adds only DEV architectureShot; quality/update paths are unchanged.
The architecture/ground merge conflict resolution changes credits and skill guidance, not runtime source.
Every measured integrated row has fewer draw calls, active meshes and rendered triangles than its matching baseline row.
result: No concrete source integration bug identified. Fresh approved-ground timings are close to integrated architecture in seven of eight rows (within 3.7% average FPS); Medium near is 10.39% lower with architecture. These single short samples do not establish repeatability or causation. The much faster historical baseline is not used as the primary comparator.
limitation: Both versions miss 60 FPS on High and Ultra, and both are below 30 FPS at Ultra far. Workload counters do not diagnose pixel/material cost, CPU cost or session effects. The cause of the earlier-versus-current timing gap, sustained behavior and ordinary-laptop performance are unmeasured.
